meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上安装并配置 claude-mem:默认启动本地 worker,也可改用远程 worker;观察者可走远程推理(openrouter/cmem.ai)或本地 host 登录。MCP 的 claude-mem-local / claude-mem-remote 与它通信。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem,需要选本地或远程 worker,或决定观察者用远程推理还是本地 host 登录时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem,用本地 worker
观察者改成本地 host 登录推理

howto.what_en: Installs and configures claude-mem on Cursor: starts a local worker (default) or a remote worker; the observer uses remote inference (openrouter/cmem.ai) or local host-login. MCP claude-mem-local / claude-mem-remote talks to it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setting up claude-mem on Cursor and choosing a local or remote worker, or picking remote inference vs local host-login for the observer.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Cursor with the local worker
Switch claude-mem to a remote worker at https://my-host
Use local host-login for the observer
